When it comes to selling digital products in restricted countries, each payment platform has its own approach. Gumroad, meanwhile, has a more relaxed approach, but it's still limited to a few payment options, and cryptocurrencies are not supported. PayPal, on the other hand, has a complex set of rules that can result in account suspension and frozen funds. Gumroad, meanwhile, offers a simple, user-friendly interface, but its automation features are limited, and delivery options are few. PayPal, on the other hand, offers a wide range of payment options, but its automation features are complex, and delivery options are limited. But there's a better way to handle ownership, automation, and delivery - by building a sovereign commerce infrastructure that puts you in control of your business, with automation features that work for you, not against you.
